card.name: Inside capitalized warning-header words
card.fires_on: A single letter piece in the middle of a long all-caps word in a boxed warning title, such as the O in EMBRYO-FETAL, the V in AGGRAVATE or the B in EXACERBATION.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the all-caps embryo-fetal toxicity warning.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,

modes.label: EXACERBATION / AGGRAVATE
modes.description: The lone B or V partway through all-caps words meaning worsening.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, perhaps a push toward words about aggression, which does not fit the contexts.
card.plain: It fires on a middle letter of long capitalized words in boxed warning titles, like EMBRYO-FETAL and EXACERBATION.
